mapper.sql: id, workplace_code, workplace_name, address, phone, status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM workplace WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY workplace_code ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE workplace SET workplace_code = #{in.workplaceCode}, workplace_name = #{in.workplaceName}, address = #{in.address}, phone = #{in.phone}, status = #{in.status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
